metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 网站 ciechanow.ski 发布了一篇关于机械表的交互式文章，通过精细的动画和逐步解释，详细展示了机械表机芯的工作原理。 这篇文章以极高的教育价值展示了如何使用纯前端技术将复杂的机械工程概念转化为直观、可探索的体验，为知识传播树立了新标杆。 网页全部由作者手工编写 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript，不依赖现代框架，甚至在旧版 iPhone 7 上也能流畅运行。文章涉及主发条、摆轮、擒纵机构等核心部件，并以交互方式让读者自由操控动画。
metadata.background_zh: 机械表依靠主发条储存能量，通过齿轮系传递动力，再由摆轮和擒纵机构共同调节能量释放的节奏，实现精确计时。擒纵机构负责周期性锁定和释放齿轮，同时给摆轮提供冲力以维持其振荡。

metadata.title_zh: 本地运行大模型是否已够好？社区存在争议
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 一篇博文认为如今本地运行语言模型已经变得可行，但社区评论指出实际使用中仍存在速度慢、量化后质量下降等痛点。 该讨论反映了本地模型与云端模型之间的权衡，直接影响用户和开发者在成本、性能与隐私之间的选择，也关系到开源模型生态的发展方向。 社区用户指出，密集模型（如Qwen 27B）虽智能但运行缓慢，混合专家模型（如Gemma 26B）速度快但易出错；4比特量化会削弱工具调用能力，导致实际体验欠佳。
metadata.background_zh: 模型量化是一种通过降低参数精度（如从32位浮点降至8位整型）来减小模型体积、加速推理的技术，但会牺牲部分准确性。本地运行大模型通常需要大量显存，量化是让高端模型在消费级显卡上运行的关键手段。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 多数评论者不同意博文观点，认为本地模型仍不够‘好’；有人提到被迫使用云端模型（如Claude Sonnet）时反而觉得更差，但也有用户指出本地模型需搭配高配置硬件，且编程工具通常免费，而AI工具的高昂月费让后者性价比存疑。

title: Apple is about to make Hide My Email useless
content:
--- Top Comments ---

[outlore]: I highly recommend either SimpleLogin or Fastmail aliases. The latter are superior because they can be used to reply directly to any received email without needing to set up reverse aliases. When you own your own domain, the switching cost between providers is small. You can make a dedicated domain just for aliases Both SimpleLogin and Fastmail have excellent integration with password managers as well

[jawiggins]: > If you use iCloud+ and Hide My Email, there is still time to generate more aliases on @icloud.com as the change has not yet landed and the rate limit for creating aliases is at least 30 per hour. Part of the reason to use Hide My Email was that it made keeping myself private hassle-free. Making a system to pre-generate values and then catalog them for later use is quite the hassle.

[giancarlostoro]: If your website will block me out because I used a privacy friendly email, I want nothing to do with your website.

[jonotime]: Pro tip for doing something like this without apple. Buy or get a cheap domain name. Create a subdomain on it and have it catch and forward all messages to you when sent to that sub. For example: nytimes@mailsub.example.com -> jono@gmail anything-else@mailsub.example.com -> jono@gmail You dont even need to materialize aliases at all.

[mortenjorck]: > Long story short: now both Sign in with Apple and Hide My Email aliases are going to be issued on the @private.icloud.com subdomain. This makes it much easier to ban all aliases without affecting non-relay mailboxes on iCloud mail.  Could someone clarify why having Sign in with Apple and Hide My Email on the same domain would make a blanket ban easier rather than harder? What am I missing?

metadata.title_zh: 苹果更改规则可能使Hide My Email功能失效
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 苹果计划将Hide My Email和Sign in with Apple生成的别名统一归于@private.icloud.com子域名下，这使得网站可以轻松屏蔽所有该子域的邮件地址。 这一变化可能严重削弱Hide My Email的隐私保护作用，因为越来越多的网站可能选择屏蔽这些“隐私友好”的邮箱地址，导致用户无法注册或接收重要邮件。 目前Hide My Email别名使用@icloud.com域名，而Sign in with Apple使用@private.icloud.com，合并后两者都使用@private.icloud.com，网站可针对性屏蔽。用户若未预先生成大量别名，后续可能受限于新规则。
metadata.background_zh: Hide My Email是苹果iCloud+的一项功能，允许用户生成随机邮箱地址转发到自己的真实邮箱，以保护隐私。Sign in with Apple也提供类似匿名邮箱服务。将别名集中到单一子域名下，网站管理员可通过简单的域名规则阻止所有此类邮箱，从而绕过隐私保护。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 评论中用户建议使用SimpleLogin或Fastmail等第三方别名服务，或自购域名设置转发，认为这样更可控。也有用户质疑将两个服务放同一子域名实际是否更易屏蔽，但普遍认为苹果此举会降低隐私实用性。

title: Is Meta destroying its engineering organization?
content:
--- Top Comments ---

[throw-the-towel]: I think the gloating in this thread is very misguided. Meta is evil, sure, but that's not the point. The point is that this kind of AI psychosis might be the new normal for our industry, or at least one of the new normals. My last workplace absolutely did a jump in toxicity when the CEO got obsessed with AI, instituted token leaderboards, told us all to drop all non-AI work for a time, etc. We were no Meta.

[ironman1478]: Having worked at meta, something I noticed is that the orgs that were well run were ones that were bought. WhatsApp, reality, insta, etc. I worked in an org that was not associated with those products and was purely homegrown and it was awful. Things got done but horribly inefficiently due to over hiring and extreme requirement and schedule shifts. I believe that the cultures that were developed outside of Meta are used to launder the image that meta as a whole has a good engineering culture.

[fabian2k]: > 30-50% of engineers on core teams have been forcefully reassigned to data labeling and RLHF, upsetting folks even more. This really doesn't sound believable to me, but who knows with all the craziness going on. Software developers in the US are seriously expensive, using them for data labeling would be a waste of resources. And the percentage sounds very high, unless "core teams" is only a small subset of the total developer count.

[PaulHoule]: Sad.  I thought Meta did a lot of things right when it came to using engineers,  especially compared to Google.  If I had a choice between React (Facebook) and Kubernetes (Google) I would pick the former anyday. Kubernetes has held back cluster technology for the last decade and prevented a better alternative for smaller companies or companies that can't piss away monopoly profits on unwieldy technology and process.  It would have been much better had somebody tried to make an open sourc...

[gwbas1c]: I think there is a shift here that a lot of people don't recognize. If you worked in TV in the early days, especially when TV was highly experimental and the standards changed every year, you probably did a lot of hands-on engineering or otherwise worked closely with engineers. Today, there is very little engineering in television. I suspect the same thing is happening with social media: The product is mature and will have less and less engineering problems to solve.

metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 一篇题为“Stop Using JWTs”的Gist文章引发了社区关于在浏览器用户会话中使用JWT安全性的激烈讨论。文章及其引用的博客指出JWT在浏览器会话中存在无法撤销令牌、安全隐患等缺陷。 该讨论对Web开发者选择会话管理方案具有重要参考价值，因为JWT在浏览器中的不当使用可能导致安全漏洞，而社区反馈揭示了更均衡的技术选择视角。 讨论强调JWT在服务间通信中仍有价值，但在浏览器会话中需要谨慎。评论指出可以通过限制令牌生命周期（如5-15分钟）并配合刷新机制来解决部分问题，同时撤销列表可以比会话数据库更小。
metadata.background_zh: JWT（JSON Web Token）是一种用于身份验证和授权的开放标准，它包含用户信息并可由服务器验证，无需访问数据库。然而在浏览器会话中，JWT一旦签发就无法撤销，直到过期，这可能导致安全风险。传统的会话管理使用服务器端存储的会话ID，可以随时撤销。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 社区意见分歧——部分开发者坚持JWT可以安全使用，通过短生命周期和刷新技术；另一些人指出JWT无法撤销是硬伤，而会话方案维护的会话列表可能非常大。还有评论提醒AWS STS等系统依赖JWT，显然经过安全审查。

metadata.title_zh: 《杀戮尖塔2》采用自定义PRNG确保种子跨平台一致
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 《杀戮尖塔2》开发团队在游戏中实现了自定义伪随机数生成器（PRNG），替代了C#标准库的随机函数，从而保证同一种子在不同平台上生成完全一致的随机序列。此前《杀戮尖塔1》因各平台标准库PRNG实现不同，导致种子不兼容。 这一改动确保了游戏种子的跨平台一致性，使玩家可以在不同设备上使用相同种子获得完全相同的游戏体验，同时避免因标准库更新导致的历史种子失效问题，对种子分享和竞速等社区活动具有重要意义。 文章指出，自定义PRNG不仅解决了平台差异，还避免了标准库未来版本变更带来的种子兼容性问题。此外，该实现可能使用了如PCG32等确定性算法，与Godot引擎自带RNG类（使用PCG32）类似。
metadata.background_zh: 伪随机数生成器（PRNG）是通过算法生成近似随机数的工具，其输出由初始种子完全决定。在游戏中，种子用于生成关卡、敌人行动等随机内容，同一种子在不同设备上应产生相同结果，以保证公平性和可复现性。若依赖平台的标准库实现，则可能因算法差异导致种子不一致。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 社区评论普遍认可该文章的技术价值，有用户赞赏HackerNews与《杀戮尖塔》社区的跨界共鸣；也有用户提到第一代游戏中存在因种子问题导致的必败局面，间接强调了种子同步的重要性；另有用户指出Godot引擎原生RNG类已使用PCG32，理论上可避免此问题，但开发团队仍选择自定义PRNG以确保完全控制。

metadata.title_zh: 浮点除法有时比整数除法更快
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 一篇技术博客指出，在某些CPU架构和编译器优化条件下，浮点除法指令的执行效率可能超过整数除法。博主通过实验和性能分析展示了这一反直觉现象。 该发现挑战了“整数运算总是比浮点运算快”的普遍认知，为性能敏感型应用的优化提供了新思路。开发者可能需要重新评估在特定场景下使用浮点除法的成本收益。 现代CPU（如Intel Core系列）的浮点除法单元延迟常低于整数除法，且编译器可能将除以常数优化为乘以其倒数（使用双倍精度乘法），进一步提升浮点数除法的效率。然而，该优势依赖于具体的数据类型和编译器选项。
metadata.background_zh: 整数除法通常被认为比浮点除法快，因为整数运算指令更简单。但实际上，CPU硬件设计对浮点运算有专门的加速路径，例如使用更高效的Sweeney-Robertson-Tocher算法或牛顿-拉夫逊迭代法。编译器也会通过常量传播将除法转换为乘法，这在浮点运算中更易实现。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: Lobste.rs上的讨论主要围绕博主提供的实验数据展开，有读者补充了其他架构（如ARM）上的测试结果，也有人指出性能差异在特定优化级别下才会显现。总体认可该发现的价值，但强调需结合具体场景验证。
